result.topic_en: Bare calculations on an elliptic-type integral u = ∫ ds/Δ with parameters x and c (derivatives with respect to x and log c, and second-order differential relations), together with left-column computations of coefficients A, B, C, D, E and expressions in a, b related to the rotating fluid ellipsoid.
result.transcription:
$A(\frac{\partial x}{\partial t})^2+2B\frac{\partial x}{\partial t}\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}+C(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t})^2$
[-$\frac{\partial}{\partial t}=0$-]
$\frac{\partial A}{\partial x}(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t})^2\frac{\partial x}{\partial t}$
$+2\frac{\partial B}{\partial c}$
$+\frac{4}{c}B$
$A'+2\frac{\partial B}{\partial c}+\frac{4}{c}B=0$
$\frac13 c^3A'+D=-2c^2B$
$B=-\frac16 cA'-\frac{1}{2c}D$
$2\frac{\partial B}{\partial x}(\frac{\partial x}{\partial t})^2\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}$
$+\frac{\partial C}{\partial c}$
$+\frac{4}{c}C$
$B'\frac25 c^5+E=-Cc^4$
$C=-\frac25 B'-\frac{E}{c^4}$
$=+\frac{1}{15}c^2A''+\frac15\frac1c D'-\frac{E}{c^4}$

$u=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+2xs+ss)(1+\frac{s}{c^3})}}=\int_x^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1-xx+ss)(1+\frac{s-x}{c^3})}}$
$uc^{-\frac32}=\int_x^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1-xx+ss)(c^3-x+s)}}=\int_{\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-xx}}}^{\infty}\frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+ss)}\sqrt{c^3-x+(1-xx)^{\frac12}s}}$
$uc^{-\frac32}(1-xx)^{-\frac14}$.
$\log(c^3-x)-\frac12\log(1-xx)=const.$
$\frac{3ccdc-\partial x}{c^3-x}+\frac{x\partial x}{1-xx}=0.$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{-s}{(1+2xs+s^2)}$
$\frac{1-xx}{-x}=1+2xs+s^2-\frac{1-xx}{x}(s+x)-(s+x)^2$
$\frac{1-xx}{x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=u-\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s+x}{1+2xs+s^2}\cdot s+\frac1x$
$=u-\frac1x-\int_0^\infty(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}d\frac{s+\frac1x}{(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{\frac12}}$
$-\frac12\int_0^\infty\frac{ds}{\Delta}(1-\frac{(\frac1x-c^3)}{s+c^3})(1+\frac{s}{c^3}-\frac{s}{c^3})$
$2-\frac{1}{xc^3}+\frac{s(\frac1x-c^3)}{c^3(s+c^3)}ds$
$d(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}=-\frac{s+x}{}$
$(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12}ds-\frac12\frac{(\frac1x-c^3)}{c^3}(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac32}ds$
$(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{\frac12}ds\,\mp(s+\frac1x)\frac{1}{2c^3}(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac32}ds$
$\frac{1-xx}{x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{2xc^3}u-\frac1x-\frac12\int_0^\infty\frac{ds}{\Delta}\frac{s(\frac1x-c^3)}{c^3(s+c^3)}$
$=\frac{1}{2xc^3}u-\frac1x-\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{xc^3}-1)$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}=-\frac12\int\frac{ds}{\Delta}\frac{-3\frac{s}{c^3}}{(1+\frac{s}{c^3})}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}=\frac32\int_0\frac{ds}{\Delta}\frac{s}{s+c^3}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s}{1+2xs+s^2}$
$\frac{1-xx}{x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac1x-\int_0^\infty(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}(s+\frac1x)d(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12}$
$\frac1x(1+\frac{s}{c^3})+s(1-\frac{1}{xc^3})$

$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=3\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s^2}{(1+2xs+s^2)^2}$
$\frac{(1-xx)}{xx}s^2=1+2xs+s^2-\frac{(1+2xs+(2-\frac1x)s)^2}{(1+\frac{s}{x})}\ 1+(2x-\frac1x)s$
$d(1+2sx+s^2)^{-\frac32}=\frac{-3(s+x)}{\Delta}$
$-\frac13\frac{1-xx}{xx}\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta(1+2xs+s^2)}-\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s+x}{(1+2xs+s^2)^2}\frac1x+(2-\frac1x)s$
$+\frac13\int_0^\infty d(1+2sx+s^2)^{-\frac32}\frac{\frac1x+(2-\frac1x)s}{(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{\frac12}}$
$-\frac{1}{3x}-\frac13\int\frac{ds}{\Delta}\frac{1}{(1+2sx+s^2)}$

$a^2=\frac{}{c}$
$a^2+b^2=2\frac{x}{c}$
$a\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}+b\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}=\frac{\partial x}{c\partial t}-x\frac{\partial c}{cc\partial t}=p$
$b\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}+a\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}=\ -\frac{1}{cc}\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}=q$
$(a^2-b^2)\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}=ap-bq$
$(b^2-a^2)\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}=bp-aq$
$(a^2-b^2)^2((\frac{\partial a}{\partial t})^2+(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2)=(a^2+b^2)(p^2+q^2)-2ab\,pq$
$a+b=\sqrt{\frac2c(x+1)}$
$a-b=\sqrt{\frac2c(x-1)}$
$(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2=\frac{1}{2c}(x+1)(\frac{\partial x}{x+1}-\frac{\partial c}{c\partial t})^2$
$(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2=\frac{1}{2c}(x-1)(\frac{\partial x}{x-1}-\frac{\partial c}{c\partial t})^2$
$(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t})^2+(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t})^2=\frac{1}{4c}((\frac{\partial x}{\partial t})^2(\frac{1}{x+1}+\frac{1}{x-1})-4\frac1c\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}\frac{\partial x}{\partial t}+2x\frac{1}{cc}(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t})^2)$

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x\partial\log c}=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{-s}{1+2xs+s^2}\cdot\frac32\frac{s}{s+c^3}$
$(\frac{1}{c^6}-\frac{2x}{c^3}+1)s^2=(1+2xs+s^2)-(1+\frac{s}{c^3})(1+(2x-\frac{1}{c^3})s)$
$1+\frac{s}{x}+(2x-\frac1x-\frac{1}{c^3})s$
$-\frac23(\frac{1}{c^6}-\frac{2x}{c^3}+1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x\partial\log c}=\int_0^\infty\frac{ds}{\Delta}(\frac{1}{s+c^3}-\frac{1+(2x-\frac{1}{c^3})s}{c^3(s+2xs+s^2)})$
$=\frac{1}{c^3}u-\frac{2}{3c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}\frac{1}{c^3}-\frac{1}{xc^3}(1-\frac{1}{2c^3}u+\frac{1}{3c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c})$
$+(2x-\frac1x-\frac{1}{c^3})\frac{1}{c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$

$s^2=d(s^2+2sx+1)+(s+x)(?s+?)$
$\frac{1-xx}{xx}s^2=(s^2+2sx+1)-(s+x)^2+\frac{1-xx}{xx}(s^2-xx)$

$u=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s}{1+2xs+s^2}\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}=\frac32\int_0^\infty\frac{ds}{\Delta}\frac{s}{s+c^3}$
$\frac{1-xx}{x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{2xc^3}u-\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{xc^3}-1)-\frac1x$
$\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s+x}{1+2xs+s^2}=-\int(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12}d(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}=+1+\int\frac{ds}{\Delta}\cdot-\frac12\frac{1}{s+c^3}(1+\frac{s}{c^3}-\frac{s}{c^3})$
$=1-\frac{1}{2c^3}u+\frac{1}{3c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$
$-\frac23(c^3+\frac{1}{c^3}-2x)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}=(x-\frac1x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{xc^3}-1)+\frac1x-\frac{1}{2xc^3}u-\frac1x$
$+(2+\frac{1}{xc^3})(-\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}+\frac12u)$
$=(x-\frac{1}{c^3})\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}+u$

$s+1=1+\frac{s}{x}+(1-\frac1x)s$
$p=\frac1x(1-\frac{1}{2c^3}u+\frac{1}{3c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c})-(1-\frac1x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-u+\frac23\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$
$=\frac1x-(1-\frac1x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{2xc^3}u+\frac{1-xx}{x(xc^3-1)}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{2xc^3(xc^3-1)}u+\frac1x\frac{1}{xc^3-1}$
$=(1-\frac1x)(\frac{1+x}{xc^3-1}-1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-u\frac{1}{2xc^3}(\frac{1}{xc^3-1}+1)+\frac1x(\frac{1}{xc^3-1}+1)$
$(xc^3-1)p=[-(x-1)-](c^3+1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac12u+c^3$
$(1+x)(xc^3-1)p=-\frac12(1+x)u+(1+x)c^3$
$+\frac12(\frac{1}{c^3}+1)u-\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(c^3+1)(\frac{1}{c^3}-x)-(c^3+1)$
$=\frac12(\frac{1}{c^3}-x)u\qquad+(xc^3-1)$

$q=\frac1x(1-\frac{1}{2c^3}u+\frac{1}{3c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c})-(1+\frac1x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+u-\frac23\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$
$(1-x)q=-\frac{1}{2xc^3}u+\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{xc^3}-1)+\frac1x+(1-x)(-\frac1x+(2+\frac{1}{xc^3})(\frac12u-\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c})$
$\frac{1}{xc^3}-1-2+2x$
$(1-xx)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}-2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{2c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac13\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{c^3}-x)+\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$
$(xx-1)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=-2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{2c^3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Definition of the integral u and its substitution form
Derivatives of u with respect to x and log c as integrals
First-order linear relation between u, u_x and u_{log c} (by integration by parts)
Evaluation of an auxiliary integral by integration by parts
Relations among coefficients A,B,C,D,E of a quadratic form in dx/dt, dc/dt
Expression of C in terms of A, D, E
Kinetic-energy type expression in a, b in terms of x, c
